cells.gaps: The digital club figures count members, not people trained, and the Zanzibar count of 1,015 is not placed in more than one location. No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills.
cells.note: The government has set up 800 digital clubs through TCRA, and Zanzibar trained 1,015 citizens by March 2026. Neither is a count of people trained shown in more than one location, so not stage 3.
